definitions.gloss: damage; destruction; to be damaged, to damage
definitions.explanation: Physical damage to buildings, roads, vehicles or other property, from a disaster, an accident or a deliberate act. A word of news reports, insurance and law.

examples.japanese: {多|おお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{家屋|かおく}→家屋：00188_kaoku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{損壊|そんかい}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{台風|たいふう}→台風：01455_taifuu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{道路|どうろ}→道路：01481_douro⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{一部|いちぶ}→一部：06783_ichibu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{損壊|そんかい}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Part of the road was damaged in the typhoon.

examples.japanese: ⟦{駅|えき}→駅：02180_eki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{自動販売機|じどうはんばいき}→自動販売機：03078_jidouhanbaiki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{損壊|そんかい}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧として、⟦{男|おとこ}→男：00561_otoko⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{器物損壊|きぶつそんかい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{疑|うたが}い→疑い：09757_utagai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{逮捕|たいほ}→逮捕：03397_taiho⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: A man was arrested on suspicion of criminal damage for wrecking a vending machine at the station.

notes:
⟦{損|そん}→損：03325_son⟧ (harm, loss) + {壊|かい} (break).

TRANSITIVITY:
Both: [building]⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{損壊|そんかい}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (is damaged) and [thing]⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{損壊|そんかい}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to damage, usually deliberately).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{家屋|かおく}→家屋：00188_kaoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{損壊|そんかい}: damage to houses
- {器物損壊|きぶつそんかい}: criminal damage to property (a crime)
- {全壊|ぜんかい} / {半壊|はんかい} / {一部損壊|いちぶそんかい}: totally / half / partly destroyed, the official grades of disaster damage

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{破損|はそん}→破損：13679_hason⟧: breakage, of objects and parts
- ⟦{損傷|そんしょう}→損傷：21079_sonshou⟧: damage or injury, also to bodies and organs
- ⟦{被害|ひがい}→被害：02572_higai⟧: harm suffered in general, including people
